english.title: Cab driver / owner carried persons in cab in excess of amount cab licenced to carry
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[driver]_

of a cab, namely **(..SPECIFY CAB..), on which was carried a person or persons, other than the driver, in excess of the number of persons which it was licensed to carry
english.legislation: Contrary to article 33(1) of the London Cab Order 1934 and section 10 of the Metropolitan Carriage Act 1869.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cab driver / owner
carried number of persons in cab
in excess of what cab is licensed to carry
whereby infant in arms shall not count as a person and two children under 10 years of age shall count as one person

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In computing such number, an infant in arms shall not count as a person and two children under 10 years of age shall count as one person.
(ii) The driver of the cab, and, unless s/he proves that the breach occurred without his/her knowledge or consent, the owner thereof, shall be liable for any breach this regulation as well.
